experience.summary: An AI research assistant that answers questions on energy access in Africa, citing evidence from a curated library of sector reports. Team of 4. I own the backend, the AI pipeline and the infrastructure.
highlights: Built the core hybrid search engine combining keyword matching (BM25) and semantic vector search (pgvector, HNSW) in PostgreSQL, delivering accurate passage retrieval without external database overhead.
Built the end-to-end RAG assistant in Python with a custom, lightweight pipeline, routing questions to AWS Bedrock (Claude) with streaming inline citations and automated Gemini fallback.
Built the asynchronous document ingestion pipeline using Redis Streams workers (consumer groups, dead-letter retries) to parse, chunk, and embed large PDFs without degrading API response times.
Designed multi-tenant data isolation and role-based access controls in PostgreSQL, letting multiple client organisations share one deployment while strictly partitioning documents.
Automated AWS infrastructure provisioning using modular nested CloudFormation stacks to deploy ECS Fargate microservices, ElastiCache Redis, and ALB, reducing environment setup from days to minutes.

experience.summary: Event ticketing platform (hoppers.ug). Built the multi-provider payment engine and high-concurrency reservation system.
highlights: Built the multi-provider payment engine (DPO, IoTec), implementing idempotent webhook handling via row-level locking to eliminate duplicate charges.
Prevented ticket overselling during demand spikes by building a high-concurrency reservation engine with guarded atomic updates in Django and database check constraints.
Enforced purchase limits and venue table reservations by serializing booking state transitions with row-level locks, eliminating checkout race conditions.
Delivered core platform features end-to-end across the Django backend, React admin panel, and mobile app, covering QR code ticket verification and role-based permissions.

Built an agentic development environment across isolated git worktrees and Dev Containers with dynamic port allocation, automating migrations, seed data, and pull requests verified by Playwright UI diffs and replayed API tests across web and Flutter apps.

experience.summary: Promoted to Senior in March 2023. Stepped away in May 2025 to complete MSc in Data Analytics full time.

Led technical design for core platform features, defining data models and API contracts while building asynchronous processing queues with Celery and RabbitMQ.
Resolved high-priority production incidents for enterprise clients, using New Relic and Sentry to trace complex bugs across distributed services and ship permanent fixes.
Ran cross-functional project planning, breaking complex product roadmaps into phased milestones and managing risk mitigation to hit scheduled release dates.
Conducted 15+ technical interviews for system design and code quality, and authored onboarding documentation for core services to accelerate new hire ramp-up.
Introduced structured logging and APM monitoring across distributed Django services with Sentry and New Relic, replacing speculative debugging with direct error-to-cause tracing.
Built talent mobility dashboards in React, enabling enterprise clients to track employee career progression and skills across their organizations.
Profiled high-latency API endpoints, eliminating N+1 database queries and implementing Memcached caching on hot data paths to cut response latency.
Automated deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker, replacing manual deployment procedures with one-click CI/CD releases.
